# FallKard

> The entry point that weaves the FallForge estate into one flow: mint a signed kard, open it to
> instantiate your own sovereign node (your structure, your look, your memory, on your metal), run it
> cheap, and join the mesh. One kard at a time. Deterministic, no LLM judge; the page runs client-side.

## The flow
Acquire (mint a signed kard) -> Instantiate (open it: structure + your skin + your memory) -> Run cheap
(render your point of view + recycle state, measured) -> Join the mesh (each kard is a node).

## Gated kernels (the page inlines them)
- kard.mjs: mintKard / attachSignature (self-sovereign Ed25519) / verifyKard / spendGate (uncrossable budget wall) / canOpen. Witness 54/55, 1 argued equivalent.
- flow.mjs: openKard / runCost / cheapVerdict (counted render-ops, with vs without — cheap is measured). Witness 15/15.

## Honest scope
The budget wall is real and enforced; selling kards/skins waits behind counsel. Cheap is a counted
measurement, not a claim. Full node-to-node mesh federation is the next layer.
